genesis_invariants: RIGHTS-INV-001: subject identity/provenance is canonical; metadata changes remain controller/capability scoped
RIGHTS-INV-002: a rights claim references an existing subject and active configured right class and commits nonzero jurisdiction/evidence
RIGHTS-INV-003: exact semantic claim replay is rejected while non-identical competing claims may coexist because 420Rights does not adjudicate legal ownership
RIGHTS-INV-004: claim supersession is explicit, links oldRightId to newRightId, and terminalizes the old claim
RIGHTS-INV-005: holder succession/transfer requires the current holder or an exact-right scoped live capability and commits succession evidence
RIGHTS-INV-006: expired or revoked delegated capabilities fail closed for rights administration
RIGHTS-INV-007: license IDs are canonical domain-separated hashes of right, licensee, scope, terms, validity, and revocability; arbitrary IDs/replay fail
RIGHTS-INV-008: a license cannot begin before its right or outlive a finite right and cannot be created against an ineffective right
RIGHTS-INV-009: right/license validity is inclusive at validFrom and validUntil and ineffective after validUntil
RIGHTS-INV-010: existing licenses survive holder succession unless independently expired, renounced, underlying claim superseded, or validly revoked
RIGHTS-INV-011: successor holders may administer inherited revocable licenses while former holders lose direct authority to issue new licenses
RIGHTS-INV-012: 420 Market may reference/list canonical license IDs but has no authority to create or mutate 420Rights state
